rules.title: Safari cache
rules.note: Downloaded page resources. History, bookmarks, passwords and open tabs live elsewhere and are not touched. Skipped while Safari is running.

rules.title: Chrome cache
rules.note: Chrome's disk cache only, never the profile in Application Support. Skipped while Chrome is running.

rules.title: Firefox cache
rules.note: The per-profile cache Firefox keeps under Caches. The profiles themselves are in Application Support and are not touched.

rules.title: Microsoft Edge cache
rules.note: Edge's disk cache only, never the profile. Skipped while Edge is running.

rules.title: Brave cache
rules.note: Brave's disk cache only, never the profile. Skipped while Brave is running.

rules.title: Arc cache
rules.note: Arc's disk cache only, never its spaces or profile. Skipped while Arc is running.

rules.title: Xcode build data
rules.note: Build products and indexes, one folder per project. Xcode rebuilds them on the next build. Skipped while Xcode is running.

rules.title: Simulator caches
rules.note: Dyld and runtime caches the Simulator regenerates. Simulator devices and their app data are not touched.

rules.title: Swift Package Manager cache
rules.note: Downloaded package repositories and manifests. Packages are fetched again on the next resolve.

rules.title: CocoaPods cache
rules.note: Downloaded pod sources and specs. pod install fetches them again.

rules.title: Carthage cache
rules.note: Downloaded dependency repositories and binaries. Carthage fetches them again.

rules.title: npm cache
rules.note: npm's content-addressed download cache. npm verifies and refills it on the next install.

rules.title: Yarn cache
rules.note: Yarn's global package cache. Projects using Plug'n'Play zero-installs keep their own copy.

rules.title: pip cache
rules.note: Downloaded and built Python wheels. pip downloads them again when needed.

rules.title: Homebrew downloads
rules.note: Bottles and source archives Homebrew already installed. Installed packages are not touched.

rules.title: Go build cache
rules.note: Compiled Go packages. go build fills it again; the module cache in ~/go is not touched.

rules.title: Device support files
rules.note: Symbols copied from each device OS version you debugged on. Xcode copies them again the next time that device connects, which can take several minutes.

rules.title: pnpm store
rules.note: Every project installed with pnpm hard-links its packages from here, so little space may come back until those projects are gone. Global installs are not touched.

rules.title: Gradle caches
rules.note: Downloaded dependencies and build caches. The next build downloads everything again, which is slow offline.

rules.title: Maven repository
rules.note: Downloaded artifacts. Artifacts you installed locally with mvn install exist only here.

rules.title: Cargo registry
rules.note: Downloaded crate sources and the registry index. Cargo fetches them again; builds need the network until it has.

rules.title: Xcode archives
rules.note: Builds you shipped, with the symbols needed to read their crash reports. Not part of a clean: review each one and remove it in Finder.

rules.title: iPhone and iPad backups
rules.note: Local device backups, often the only one. Not part of a clean: check the date in Finder's device list before removing one.

rules.title: macOS installer leftovers
rules.note: Left behind by a macOS update, owned by the system. Not part of a clean: it needs an administrator, and an update in progress still uses it.

rules.title: macOS service caches
rules.note: Caches of macOS's own services. They are rebuilt, but some services download their data again or run slower until they have.

rules.title: App caches
rules.note: Apps rebuild their caches when needed. A cache is skipped while its app runs, a file in it is open, or it changed in the last 10 minutes. A cache whose app cannot be told from its name is listed but not selected.

rules.title: App logs
rules.note: Diagnostic logs not written to for a week.
